assets.subject: Independent lantern porter mount concept
assets.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL stylized fantasy game creature concept, designed from the practical function of a walking porter carrying a rider, with no reference to existing game characters or models. One sturdy, friendly, broad-backed bipedal creature with thick legs, natural balancing arms and a practical harness carrying a single EMPTY secure rider chair; two small detachable lanterns visibly attached to separate harness points. Show a clear exact SIDE VIEW, standing neutrally, complete figure including head, feet, chair and both lanterns, generously within frame on a perfectly plain white background. No rider, people, landscape, extra objects, lettering, numbers, symbols, logo, watermark, border or cast shadow. Simple clear anatomy and distinct harness, hand-painted stylized fantasy concept suitable for later independent 3D interpretation. No scale or dimensions. Do not imitate any existing game or artist.
assets.retry: A second side-profile attempt was reviewed; the first was selected for clearer lanterns and figure. Both have a slight three-quarter angle.
validation_needed: Creature is bird-like; reconcile with the existing Lanternback Troll identity before selecting as a replacement
Rig and idle, walk, run and death animation
Moving rider seat and light attachment bones
Locomotion cadence, scale and grounded feet
Rider and harness clipping across poses
Preload, performance, graphics tiers and in-game review
